versions.content: After the reception of a First Frame or Single Frame, if the func- tion PduR_CanTpStartOfReception () returns BUFREQ_OK with a smaller available buffer size than needed for the already received data, the CanTp module shall abort the reception of the N-SDU and call PduR_CanTpRxIndication () with the result E_- NOT_OK .
